note: Retained extraction proposals r0001–r0007; owner source-verified, no apply or editorial-decisions record.

proposals.before: The handle, from Huazhi to the southwest.
proposals.after: The handle, from Mount Hua to the southwest.
proposals.reason: 自華以西南: 華 is Mount Hua (华山); Huazhi misreads the monosyllable place name.

proposals.before: The handle marks the region from Huazhi southwestward.
proposals.after: The handle marks the region from Mount Hua southwestward.
proposals.reason: 自華以西南: 華 is Mount Hua (华山); Huazhi misreads the monosyllable place name.

proposals.before: Contraction, its state has worries, will perish, state collapse and fail.
proposals.after: Contraction, its state has worries, the general will perish, state collapse and fail.
proposals.reason: 縮，其國有憂，將亡: idiomatic already renders 將 as the general; literal must match paired English.
proposals.sourceZh: 縮，其國有憂，將亡，國傾敗。

proposals.before: In Chu, there was Tang Mei;
proposals.after: Under the Xia, there was Kunwu;
proposals.reason: 有夏，昆吾 is Xia-era Kunwu; current text duplicates s0765 楚，唐眛.

proposals.before: To the northwest are the Hu, Mo, Yuezhi, and other peoples who wear felt and fur and draw bows; they correspond to yin;
proposals.after: The twenty-eight lodges govern the twelve provinces, and the Dipper's handle encompasses them all; this has long been so.
proposals.reason: 二十八舍主十二州，斗秉兼之，所從來久矣; current English is s0789 northwest-barbarians text.
proposals.sourceZh: 二十八舍主十二州，斗秉兼之，所從來久矣。
